name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: An animated combobox for React and shadcn, with filtering, a clear button and multi-select chips.

meta.details: A filterable select whose list drops 4px from the field, whose clear button pops in, and whose chips pop in from 0.9 on the snappy spring and leave fast.

docs: Import Combobox from components/eased/combobox/combobox; pass items as { value, label } objects (flat or grouped), add multiple for chips, and wrap it in Field for a label. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
